messages:
anya: Heads up — planning to flip the precision flag `modelx.precision.v2` -> int4 for a tiny cordon tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Target: 5% traffic for 30m. Quick checklist before I schedule: @matt infra readiness, @kai guardrails, @lia eval sweep. Any objections? :eyes:

matt: infra is good. int4 kernels baked on the canary pool. I'll attach a temporary rate cap (50r/s) and a fallback route to fp16. Adding `circuit_breaker` with immediate kill switch. :thumbsup:

kai: agree on kill switch. Request we enforce these guardrails: p99 < 1200ms, error rate < 0.5% (5m window), and model quality regression alert if delta_quality > 1.5%. I'll wire alerts to #incidents and pager if violated. Also will ensure KV-cache warm-up window (5m) before counting traffic.

lia: running a final eval sweep tonight on the production prompt set (eval job id: ej-2345). Local runs show ~0.8% metric delta vs fp16 on our smoke set, but I'll publish a full breakdown. If any metric crosses 1.5% regression we'll flip back immediately. Planning to push results by 23:30 UTC.

redwood-deploy-bot: Scheduled toggle created: `modelx.precision.v2` -> int4 @ 2003-01-17T02:00:00Z (5% traffic). Smoke tests: PASS. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-flip-2003001234.

anya: Config snippet for the toggle (for ops copy/paste):
```
redwood flag set modelx.precision.v2 int4 --pct 5 --ramp 30m --kill-switch modelx.precision.v2.disable
```

lia: added a short post-rollout evaluation job that runs at +15m and +30m and pushes results to `metrics/quality/regression`. If regression > 1.5% at either point, automation will trigger the kill-switch.

matt: I'll limit ingress to the canary pool and tag instances `quant-cordon-small-alpha`. Also adding a short-term autoscale cap so we don't burst capacity during warm-up.

kai: I'll monitor live telemetry; if p99 > 2s or error rate spikes, I'll post to #incidents and escalate to oncall (@mike). Please make sure ops knows the exact kill-switch name.

anya: thanks all — unless I hear objections by EOD I'll schedule. Quick doc note: audience buckets = ["small-alpha", "prod-ops-observers"], control = fp16 95%, experiment = int4 5%. I'll ping again after the 23:30 evals. :v:
